title: megatron: torch-load-any @ checkpointing.py:1739
install: git checkout <pinned tag> (source is vendored under lab/upstream_verify/upstream/)

root_cause.note: torch.load(checkpoint_name, map_location='cpu') with no weights_only pin inside the Megatron-LM checkpoint loader: a poisoned checkpoint directory executes pickle code on resume. Reproduced against the verbatim pinned checkpointing.py; megatron.* siblings stubbed because megatron-core 0.19.x hard-imports triton, torch is real 2.5.1+cpu where weights_only still defaults to False.

preconditions: attacker can write the Megatron checkpoint directory
victim resumes training or loads a biencoder checkpoint from it
steps: load the verbatim pinned checkpointing.py with megatron siblings stubbed
write a poisoned model_optim_rng.pt plus the iteration tracker
call the real loader and observe marker creation inside torch.load
cleanup: temporary checkpoint directory under evidence/ is rewritten on every run
